quotations.old_english: Aaron and lulius wǽron burhwarumen (burhwaru, burhwealdan) on Ligeceastre

source_text: burgwaru-mann, burg-wealda (burh-). Add :-- Aaron and lulius wǽron burhwarumen (burhwaru, burhwealdan) on Ligeceastre Aaron et Iulius Legionum urbis ciues, Bd. 1. 7; Sch. 27, 17.
